label: ADVISORY. AI-written explanation of the QorTime referee's results. It does not decide or change the verdict.
built_during: Meta AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026
explanation:
STATUS VERIFIED

This was a Madden27 single match on PS5, claimed as away win 10 to 0 in quarter 4 from the end menu read, with final confirmed.

What passed: bundle structure, capture chain, challenges, final re-read, input integrity, motion and video bytes. The referee re-read of the end menu matches the claimed final. Referee qortime-online-s2 with trusted key qortime-v1 serial 2. No errors and nothing missing. 166 of 525 video segments were checked by spot-check.

Controller input looks human-like but is advisory only, not proof of a human player.

Not proven: who was holding the controller, that laptop countersignatures were made live, that footage was not made up before hashing, and content of segments not received.

advisory_key.role: advisory only; not a referee key; cannot make or change a verdict
